mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, thereby increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by more than 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: When UNRATE increases by more than 0.3pp in 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of the cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their respective 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand and economic activity, which signals strong corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC less than 0.03 with 20-day returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined as a sustained increase in the federal funds rate over 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.2pp over 3 months), the average 20-day forward return is not negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing and industrial activity, which signals stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 700.0 thousand units signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is below 700.0, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of the observations over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) has a Rank IC less than 0.03 with 20-day returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (defined as a GDP growth rate above 2.5% with deceleration over the last 6 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to expectations of monetary tightening and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (GDP growth rate > 2.5% with deceleration), the 60-day forward returns are not negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
